next_step: Closed-lost to EdgeVault; re-evaluate 2026 if appliance path considered
closed_reason: Security mandate required fully air-gapped appliance with removable media updates and physically isolated key custody. Bastion selected a competitor that offered an offline-only appliance and vendor-led on-site install. Redwood Private could not commit to zero-control-plane egress within procurement timeline.
notes:
Deal status: stalled -> closed-lost. Primary driver: absolute air-gap requirement from Safety & Compliance after a recent audit. Secondary drivers: procurement wanted turnkey appliance and a single-vendor SLA for on-site support. Internal champion (Head of Automation) unexpectedly left company in late July which removed momentum and advocacy.

Recent timeline bullets:
- 2025-03-12: Lead created after inbound form (Marisol). Use case: camera-based QA + operator assistance at 6 plants.
- 2025-04-10: Intro + architecture call (Marisol, Daniel) 1 initial fit; ask to scope local inferencing and offline logging. Fireflies ff_2025-04-10_1099.
- 2025-05-07: SE deep-dive; provided design for Redwood Private in VPC with offline caching and KMS options. Customer requested physical key custody (FIPS/HSM).
- 2025-06-11: Security workshop; compliance team insisted on zero outbound connections from inference hosts. Requested vendor to install and maintain appliance without telemetry.
- 2025-07-02: POC quote requested for air-gapped appliance + 90-day on-site support. Redwood clarified control-plane dependency for billing/rollouts; suggested manual billing export and isolated ops mode as workaround.
- 2025-07-30: Champion left company. Procurement slowed; budget earmarked only for appliance vendors.
- 2025-08-18: Final decision call; Bastion informed Redwood they were selecting EdgeVault Systems; EdgeVault offered removable-media update process and signed NDA for onsite engineers. Fireflies ff_2025-08-18_6622.
- 2025-08-28: Account updated to closed-lost in CRM by Marisol.

Quotes from customer:
- "If there is any outbound telemetry we fail compliance 1 cannot risk it." 1 Senior Compliance Officer.
- "We would pay a premium for a truly offline appliance with onsite support." 1 Director of Ops.

Customer requirements summary:
- No outbound network from inference cluster; absolute air-gap.
- On-site HSM/FIPS 140-2 for key custody; keys never leave facility.
- Removable-media updates or vendor-managed physical updates.
- On-site installation, runbooks, and 24x7 local escalation for 90 days.
- Audit logs retained for 10 years on local archival system.

Redwood notes / internal comments:
- Redwood Private currently assumes a private-managed control plane with optional restricted telemetry; not architected for true air-gapped appliance.
- SE proposed mitigations: local-only telemetry buffer with signed manifests, manual software patching, and offline billing reconciliation; customer rejected as insufficient.
- Product asks: evaluate a formal offline-appliance roadmap and pricing model for high-security regulated manufacturers.

Recommended internal follow-ups:
- Mark closed-lost, primary reason = air-gapped requirement.
- Add to 2026 re-engagement list if market demand for offline appliance increases.
- Capture feature request ticket for air-gap installer and removable-media update path.

Tags: closed-lost, air-gapped, on-prem, security-blocker, competitor-edgevault
additional_context: Bastion prioritized vendors that could provide hands-on physical installs and guaranteed zero external connectivity. They temporarily freed budget for appliance purchases; unlikely to re-open in next 6 months without regulatory pressure.
